escenas.texto: This week in Oceania, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over one hundred million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Oceania edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Oceania. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. At number ten, W.O Kpop 💝, with “Sophia when the awards slipped out of Yoonchae's hands?”. Over two million views. A Short of just twelve seconds. It also has sixty-nine comments.

Number nine, from New Zealand, dmxruser, with “One simple trick”. Over two million views. And get this: it's a channel with about fifteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifteen seconds.

In position number eight, from Australia, TGG, with “1 Hour of GTA 6 Free-Roam Gameplay”. Over two point one million views. A video over sixty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over two thousand comments.

Number seven, from New Zealand, Drama Investigator, with “You hit a car, not run into your crush”. Over two point eight million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and fifty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eight seconds.

Number six, from New Zealand, Amit Sharma, with “She Found a Genius Way to Keep Jensen Home NVIDIA GPU Giveaway”. Over three point two million views. And get this: it's a channel with about sixteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-nine seconds.

Coming in at number five, Step Bloom, with “Comment BUMP if your kids would love these!”. Over three point four million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one thousand, one hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twelve seconds.

Next up, number four, Bloxy Productions, with “Why You Exist.”. Over three point seven million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has eight hundred and thirty-three comments.

Bronze medal, Owls in Towels, with “How to Wrap an Owl”. Over three point nine million views. And get this: it's a channel with about four thousand, two hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifteen seconds.

Silver medal, from Australia, CrackerMilk, with “Swimming between the flags”. Over seven point four million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-three seconds.
Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, from Australia, LazarBeam, with “Testing Everything In GTA 6”. Over eight point five million views. It also has over one thousand comments.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Next up, number ten, emma & georgia , with “So excited omg!!”. Over one thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It got there in just one day.
At number nine, from Australia, Karl Jobst, with “Shocking Cheating Scandal In Black Ops 3 Zombies”. Over one thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over one million views.

At number eight, from Australia, CrackerMilk, with “Swimming between the flags”. Over one thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-three seconds.
Number seven, from Australia, LazarBeam, with “Testing Everything In GTA 6”. Over one thousand comments. It also has over eight point five million views.

Number six, from Australia, TGG, with “1 Hour of GTA 6 Free-Roam Gameplay”. Over two thousand comments. A video over sixty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over two point one million views.
Number five, from Australia, Lessons in Meme Culture, with “GTA 6 Has Become A Meme”. Over two thousand comments. It also has over eight hundred and eighty-four thousand views.

Coming in at number four, from New Zealand, RadicalSoda, with “Breeding YouTuber Trauma with my FNAF QUIZ”. Over two thousand comments. A video over seventy minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one million views.
Bronze medal, from Australia, SAMTIME, with “People Aren’t Happy About GTA 6”. Over three thousand comments. It also has over eight hundred and sixty-two thousand views.

Silver medal, Owls in Towels, with “How to Wrap an Owl”. Over three thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about four thousand, two hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifteen seconds.

And here it is. Number one most commented, from New Zealand, Dolan Darkest, with “Is GTA 6 Completely Cooked”. Over four thousand comments. It also has over six hundred and eighty-four thousand views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Number ten, emma & georgia , with “So excited omg!!”. Over forty-seven thousand likes. It got there in just one day. It also has over eight hundred and sixty-one thousand views.

In position number nine, Gerard Briones, with “Is this normal?”. Over fifty-two thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about three thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just forty-seven seconds.

In position number eight, from New Zealand, dmxruser, with “One simple trick”. Over fifty-five thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about fifteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifteen seconds.

In position number seven, from New Zealand, Drama Investigator, with “You hit a car, not run into your crush”. Over fifty-six thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and fifty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eight seconds.
In position number six, Zack D. Films, with “How Electricity Reveals Hidden Fingerprints”. Over sixty-four thousand likes. A Short of just twenty-eight seconds. It got there in just one day.

At number five, from New Zealand, Viva La Dirt League, with “Enemies in Red Dead 2 be like”. Over eighty-four thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over one point two million views.

In position number four, Owls in Towels, with “How to Wrap an Owl”. Over one hundred and ten thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about four thousand, two hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifteen seconds.
Bronze medal, from Australia, LazarBeam, with “Testing Everything In GTA 6”. Over one hundred and sixteen thousand likes. It also has over eight point five million views.

Silver medal, from Australia, CrackerMilk, with “Swimming between the flags”. Over one hundred and twenty thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-three seconds.
Drum roll, please. Number one most liked, Bloxy Productions, with “Why You Exist.”. Over one hundred and seventy-seven thousand likes. It also has over three point seven million views.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Asia. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Oceania every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
